plugins.name: RitoTex for Photoshop
plugins.summary: Open and save .tex and .dds textures in Photoshop.
plugins.description:
Lets you open and save Riot's .tex format in Photoshop, with .dds support too. A .tex opens like any other image and saves back with File > Save As.

Supports BC1, BC3, BC5, BC7 and uncompressed, mipmaps (auto or from layers), normal-map flip and renormalize, and a compression preview. Needs 64-bit Photoshop CS6 or newer.

plugins.name: TEX for Paint.NET
plugins.summary: Open and save .tex textures in Paint.NET.
plugins.description:
Adds .tex support to Paint.NET. Open files normally or drag them in; saving picks the compression for you, or use the 'with options' file type to set the format, dithering and mipmaps yourself.

Supports DXT1, DXT5, BC5, BC7 and uncompressed, with fast GPU BC7 saving. Needs a current Paint.NET on Windows 10 or later.

plugins.name: TEX for GIMP
plugins.summary: Open and export .tex textures in GIMP.
plugins.description: Adds .tex support to GIMP, in the normal open and export dialogs. Works with both GIMP 2 and GIMP 3 — Onyx installs the right build into every version it finds. Restart GIMP after installing.

plugins.name: RitoShark for Maya
plugins.summary: Import and export League models, skeletons, animations and maps in Maya.
plugins.description:
Imports and exports .skn, .skl, .anm, .scb, .sco and .mapgeo in Maya, under File > Import and File > Export Selection. Uses the RitoShark library for the file formats.

After installing, enable ritoshark_plugin.py in Windows > Settings/Preferences > Plug-in Manager. Needs Maya 2023 or newer.

plugins.name: Aventurine for Blender
plugins.summary: Import and export League models, skeletons and animations in Blender.
plugins.description:
Imports and exports SKN meshes, SKL skeletons and ANM animations in Blender 4.0 and newer. The tools are in the 3D viewport N-panel, under the 'Aventurine LoL' tab.

Also has a physics simulation based on Wiggle 2 and animation retargeting between rigs.

plugins.name: Texture Thumbnails
plugins.summary: Shows previews for .tex files in Windows Explorer.
plugins.description:
Makes Explorer show previews for .tex files instead of a blank icon — in the file list, the preview pane and the icon views. Supports every .tex format, including BC7 and BC5.

Windows caches thumbnails, so files you browsed before installing keep the old look until the file changes or the cache is cleared (Disk Cleanup > Thumbnails).

plugins.name: Hematite
plugins.summary: Finds and fixes broken League skins.
plugins.description:
A command-line tool that finds and fixes broken League skins. Give it a .fantome, .wad.client or .bin and it repairs the file in place; give it a folder and it fixes everything inside. --dry-run previews without writing, --check only identifies the champion and skin.

The fix rules update from GitHub on their own, so most breakages get fixed without a new exe.
